mapper.select: select b.buyer_user_id,b.order_id,b.order_shipping_code,e.express_pinyin from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base b left join ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_express e on b.order_shipping_express_id = e.express_id where HOUR(TIMEDIFF(now(),b.order_shipping_time ))>50 and b.order_status ='4'
